versions.content: BSW Interface Variation Points The variation points in the scope of BswModuleDescription with latestBindingTime = preCompileTime allow to declare variable sets of optional documentation, communication interfaces, dependencies, triggers and mode groups as part of one BSW module description. Further variation points in this hierarchy with can be bound at compile-time are not allowed in order to keep the meta-model and the resulting M1 models maintainable.
